    10	 * This is only a subset of generic endian behavior. OpenEXR is
    11	 * defined as little endian, so we only care about host <-> little
    12	 * endian and not anything with big endian.
    13	 */
    14	#if defined(__linux__) || defined(__CYGWIN__)
    15	
    16	#    include <endian.h>
    17	#    define EXR_HOST_IS_NOT_LITTLE_ENDIAN (__BYTE_ORDER != __LITTLE_ENDIAN)

    23	#    define EXR_HOST_IS_NOT_LITTLE_ENDIAN (BYTE_ORDER != LITTLE_ENDIAN)
    24	#    if EXR_HOST_IS_NOT_LITTLE_ENDIAN
    25	#        if defined(_MSC_VER)
    26	#            define htole16(x) _byteswap_ushort (x)
    27	#            define le16toh(x) _byteswap_ushort (x)
    28	#            define htole32(x) _byteswap_ulong (x)
    29	#            define le32toh(x) _byteswap_ulong (x)

    31	#            define le64toh(x) _byteswap_uint64 (x)
    32	#        elif defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
    33	#            define htole16(x) __builtin_bswap16 (x)
    34	#            define le16toh(x) __builtin_bswap16 (x)
    35	#            define htole32(x) __builtin_bswap32 (x)
    36	#            define le32toh(x) __builtin_bswap32 (x)

    38	#            define le64toh(x) __builtin_bswap64 (x)

    41	#        endif
    42	#    else
    43	#        define htole16(x) (x)
    44	#        define le16toh(x) (x)
    45	#        define htole32(x) (x)
    46	#        define le32toh(x) (x)
